record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: On the unit disk D, with A^p the Bergman space and T_a the Toeplitz operator generated by a symbol a, find a necessary and sufficient condition for compactness of T_a on A^p when the symbol is only locally integrable, or even distributional. The paper asks for such a criterion at least in the Hilbert case p = 2.

evidence.quote: Problem 3. Find a necessary and sufficient condition for Toeplitz operators with L1loc (or even distributional) symbols to be compact on Bergman spaces Ap (at least in the case p = 2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ be the open unit disk, equipped with normalized area measure $dA$. For $1\le p<\infty$, the Bergman space $A^p=A^p(\mathbb{D})$ is the closed subspace of $L^p(\mathbb{D},dA)$ consisting of holomorphic functions on $\mathbb{D}$. Let $P:L^2(\mathbb{D},dA)\to A^2$ denote the orthogonal Bergman projection, given by
$$ (Pf)(z)=\int_\mathbb{D}\frac{f(w)}{(1-z\overline{w})^2}\,dA(w). $$
For a symbol $a$ (a priori a measurable function, or more generally a distribution on $\mathbb{D}$ for which the following expression is well defined on a dense subspace of $A^p$), the Toeplitz operator $T_a$ is defined by
$$ T_a f = P(a f). $$

Problem. Find a necessary and sufficient condition on the symbol $a$ for $T_a$ to extend to a compact operator on $A^p(\mathbb{D})$, in the case where $a$ is only assumed to be locally integrable on $\mathbb{D}$ (i.e.\ $a\in L^1_{\text{loc}}(\mathbb{D})$), or more generally a distribution on $\mathbb{D}$. The case $p=2$ is of primary interest.
artifact.status_search_result: Sufficient conditions for compactness of Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces (e.g., via membership in weighted Sobolev spaces of negative order) have been obtained, and necessary conditions such as vanishing of the Berezin transform on the boundary are known. However, no complete necessary and sufficient characterization of compactness for $T_a$ on $A^p(\mathbb{D})$ with merely $L^1_{\text{loc}}$ or distributional symbols is known, even for $p=2$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Belonging of the symbol to a weighted Sobolev space of negative order is sufficient for boundedness; a corresponding sufficient condition for compactness is also derived.
status_evidence.claim: Only sufficient conditions for compactness in the distributional setting are established; no necessary and sufficient criterion is given.

status_evidence.title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3. Find a necessary and sufficient condition for Toeplitz operators with L1loc (or even distributional) symbols to be compact on Bergman spaces Ap (at least in the case p = 2).
